observations: Photo 0: A white PlayStation 5 console standing upright, disc-slot style front panel (wide 'Fat' body shape), with one white DualSense controller leaning against it.
Photo 0: A coiled black cable (looks like HDMI or power cable) still wrapped in plastic, lying beside the controller.
Photo 1: Close-up of the same console's side/back, showing a visible slot consistent with a disc drive edition, plus the same controller and cable.
No screen-on/boot image, no serial number plate, no box, no FIFA disc, no second controller, and no receipt are visible in either photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI...E GAMES' present on both images; no other text or model plate is legible.

response.reason: The photos clearly show a Sony PS5 Fat disc-edition console with one controller and a cable, but none of the seller's functional or completeness claims (working ports, no repairs, second pad, FIFA disc, UK receipt) are visible or verifiable, so it must be priced at the worst case as an unverified single-controller PS5 Fat unit.
